policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Document is explicitly non-binding soft law using a goal-based approach. It integrates three previous guidelines (AI R&D Guidelines, AI Utilization Guidelines, Governance Guidelines Ver.1.1). Intended as a living document to be updated via agile governance. Full policy details are in Parts 2-5 which are not fully represented in the extracted text.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document primarily frames AI governance around ensuring safe and secure use of AI in business contexts, reducing social risks such as misinformation, IP infringement, and other harms that arise from AI deployment. The goal-based, risk-based approach is centered on protecting society from AI risks while enabling innovation, with safety and security language dominant throughout.
